title: loreya umbellata
intro: Loreya umbellata, commonly known as the Loreya or Lobelia, is a flowering plant species in the bellflower family. It is native to tropical regions of Asia and has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is valued for its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. Loreya umbellata contains bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions including its potential to lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health.
